records.name: Pig Iron Theatre Company
records.summary: A Philadelphia theater ensemble that makes new performance work, trains performers at its own school, and rents its studios to other artists.
records.what_you_do: Take training through Pig Iron School, come to a student showing or a public show, or attend the Lecoq Symposium or the yearly benefit. The company also lists jobs and internships.

schedule.text: Shows, student showings and events are listed by date on the company website. Class times were not shown on the pages read.

locations.label: Company address (from IRS and Cultural Fund records)

cost.text: No prices were shown for classes or tickets on the pages read.

first_step.how: Look up the Pig Iron School training on the company site, or come to a public show or student showing to see the work first.
first_step.basis: Shows and student showings are open to the public and listed by date; the way into the school was not spelled out on the pages read.

records.notes: The company's own pages showed no street address, and the public email is hidden on the site, so it was not copied. The street address comes from IRS and Cultural Fund records. Devised theater and training school: no exact interest tag exists, so interests is empty. The newest dated item is 'A Day Celebrating Dito' on 2026-09-27 at Miller Theater.

records.name: Directors Gathering
records.summary: A community for theater directors in Philadelphia that holds free salons and gatherings where directors look at their process, try projects they might not otherwise attempt, and meet each other.
records.what_you_do: Come to a free salon or community gathering in person or on Zoom, sign up for the free Basic membership for event access and digital resources, or donate.

schedule.text: Events are listed by date. The newest dated event is September 21, 2026, 6 to 8 pm, in person in Philadelphia. Summer Salon Series sessions are free. The site says a longer membership relaunch is planned for 2026.

cost.text: The events shown are free and the Basic membership is free. Donation amounts are not listed.

first_step.how: Sign up for the free Basic membership, or RSVP for the next free event on the Directors Gathering site (some events ask for an RSVP by a set date).
first_step.basis: Events are free and open to the public, and the site explains how to RSVP and join the free tier.

records.notes: No public email or phone was readable on the page read. The website is listed on the September 21 event flyer. There is no exact interest tag for a theater director community, so interests is empty. The Basic membership tier launched in March 2025.

records.name: Jazz Bridge Project
records.summary: A nonprofit that helps jazz and blues musicians in the Philadelphia area through hard times, pays musicians for neighborhood concerts, and gives audiences a chance to meet the performers.
records.what_you_do: Come to a jazz or blues concert, volunteer (the site has a volunteer page), or donate and sign up for the newsletter.

schedule.text: Concerts are listed by date: Collingswood on November 19, 2026, Cheltenham on December 2, 2026, and more dates into May 2027. Times were not in the summary read.

locations.label: Office (from IRS and Cultural Fund records)

cost.text: Concert prices were not shown. Tickets are sold through an outside ticketing page.

first_step.how: Buy a ticket to the next listed concert (Collingswood on November 19, 2026 or Cheltenham on December 2, 2026), or ask about the volunteer page to help at events.
first_step.basis: Concerts are open to the public with tickets, and the site lists volunteer and newsletter sign-ups.

records.notes: Concerts take place in Cheltenham, PA and Collingswood, NJ, outside the city. Kept as publish because the group serves Philadelphia-area musicians and holds a Cultural Fund grant; the owner may decide whether suburban concerts belong in the directory. No public email or phone was seen. Status is active because the concert calendar runs from November 2026 to May 2027; no past dated post was read.
